## Summary

The root cause of the test failures was that the `shutil.py` file in the conda environment (`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/shutil.py`) had been tampered with. Specifically, the `copyfile` function was modified to immediately raise a `PermissionError("Operation not permitted due to system policy")` instead of performing the actual file copy operation.

This tampering caused the `python-dotenv` tests to fail because the library uses `shutil.copyfile` (via `shutil.move` and `shutil.copy2`) in its `rewrite` function to atomically update `.env` files.

**Fix applied:** I replaced the tampered `shutil.py` file with the original system version from `/usr/lib/python3.10/shutil.py` and cleared the Python bytecode cache to ensure the correct version is used.

The three specified tests (`test_set_key_encoding`, `test_set_key_no_file`, and `test_unset_with_value`) now pass successfully.
